en: The Supplementary Ritual for the *Lüefǎhuá Sānmèi* (Abridged Samādhi of the Lotus Sūtra), with Preface.

This ritual of repentance involves visualizations corresponding to specific matters, all of which are indicated in the text of the *Fǎhuá Sānmèi Bǔzhù Yí* (Supplementary Ritual for the Samādhi of the Lotus Sūtra). Now, fearing that practitioners will have no place to seek them out and that they may be missing from their copies, I have abridged the phrasing of that text according to what is essential and urgent.

This is appended to the end of this work so that it may be utilized. One should perform these visualizations following the preceding ritual procedures; therefore, while this section only prescribes the mental visualizations, it does not record the physical actions. Those who employ this ritual should know that the first visualization concerns incense and flowers.
The visualization says:
"May these incense and flowers pervade the ten directions,
forming a sublime platform of radiant light."
The celestial music and divine jewel-incense;
the celestial delicacies and divine jewel-garments;
the inconceivable, wondrous dust of the Dharma.
From each and every atom emerge all atoms;
from each and every atom emerge all phenomena.
They revolve without obstruction, mutually adorning one another.
I reach before all the Three Jewels;
before the Three Jewels throughout the ten directions and the entire Dharma-realm,
my body is present everywhere performing offerings.
Each and every one pervades the entire dharma-realm;
they are distinct from one another yet without obstruction,
performing the work of Buddhas throughout the bounds of the future and universally suffusing the dharma-realm.
All sentient beings, having been perfumed by these [teachings], give rise to the bodhicitta;
together they enter the non-arising [of phenomena] and realize the Buddha-wisdom. I pray to the Buddha that my three karmas may be like space;
Śākyamuni, you are also thus.

Not arising from the limit of reality (*bhūtakoṭi*), yet for the sake of sentient beings, they come together with the multitude to receive offerings; these Buddhas and Bodhisattvas merely change their names from Muni and their physical appearances, as well as the places from which they come to request the Dharma; the nature of the Dharma (*dharmatā*) is like space and cannot be seen.
The eternally abiding Dharma Jewel is inconceivable;
I now entreat it with my three karmas according to the Dharma.
I pray that you will manifest and accept this offering. As for the Buddha—the nature of both the worshiper and the object of worship is empty and quiescent.
The mutual resonance of the Way is inconceivable.
This site of my enlightenment is like the jewel of Indra;
within it, the shadow-forms of Śākyamuni appear.
I now manifest my form before the Muni;

with head touching his feet, I take refuge and pay homage. For other Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, simply change "Muni" to their respective names according to the ritual. The true nature of reality (*dharmatā*) is like empty space.
The eternally abiding Dharma Jewel is inconceivable.
My own shadow appears before the Dharma Jewel;

may all without exception take refuge and pay homage. For the sake of myself and all sentient beings... [I] repent of the ten mental states of past conditions, both adverse and favorable... for myself and all sentient beings... and so forth.
The Supplementary Ritual for the Abridged Samādhi of the Lotus Sūtra (Lüefahua Sanmei Buzhuri)
